card.name: Preparation headings in dosing sections
card.fires_on: The word preparation (or its partial forms such as PAR in PREPARATION, or 'of' right after it) in headings and cross-references about preparing a drug for administration. It also fires on the NEL in PERSONNEL in a warning header.

modes.label: Preparation heading
modes.description: The word Preparation or the 'of' after it in a numbered section title about preparing a solution or suspension.

modes.label: Preparation with administration
modes.description: Preparation or administration named together as instructions to follow.
modes.example: See full prescribing information for information on<< preparation>>, administration, dosing considerations and instructions

modes.label: Split capitalized word
modes.description: Partway through the capitalized words PREPARATION or PERSONNEL in a header.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where instructions for preparing a drug are being introduced.
